Title: Azure Search Basic Unit and Standard Unit Resource GUID change

Body.Content:
Azure Search customers in the Japan East region are currently billed using Japan East meter IDs (resource GUIDs). Effective July 1, 2019, your meter IDs for Azure Search Basic, Standard S1, S2 and S3 Units will be migrated to a Japan East meter. This migration will impact only the meter ID and naming. The rate you pay for the service will not change with the new meter. You will need to modify billing routines that rely on the meter’s naming attributes before July 1, 2019. 

See the table below for meter ID and name change details.
